data.message_en:

PNS answer rate is 40.3% (should be 60%+).
One quick phone setting fixes this. 📞
data.cta: Reply YES to fix missed calls

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, The Jain Lock Factory se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, 8,000 din se bhi zyada, lekin is mahine aapke business leads mein 52.8% ki girawat aayi hai, toh seedha baat karne ke liye call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ek cheez samajhna tha — jab koi buyer aapko PNS pe call karta hai, kya aap us waqt available nahi hote ya phone kisi aur reason se miss ho jaata hai? Kyunki hamare records mein dikh raha hai ki 10 mein se sirf 4 calls aap receive kar pa rahe hain.
script_parts.value_demo: Dekho ji, jo sellers Aligarh mein locks ka catalog rakhte hain aur PNS answer rate 60% se upar maintain karte hain, unhe consistently zyada buyer responses milte hain — aapka abhi 40.3% hai, matlab har 6 mein se 3-4 buyers seedha competitor ke paas chale jaate hain bina baat kiye.
script_parts.action: Abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — aapka PNS schedule open karte hain aur jo time slots aap genuinely available rehte hain, wahi set karte hain, taaki system sirf tab ring kare jab aap phone uthaa sako; 5 minute lagenge.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, bas yeh ek change aaj kar lete hain — PNS timing theek ho gayi toh agli 2 hafton mein lead response naturally improve hoga; koi bada commitment nahi, sirf yeh ek step.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with The Jain Lock Factory? This is calling from IndiaMART — your account is over 8,000 days old, which is great, but this month your business leads have dropped by 52.8%, so I wanted to speak directly about what's happening.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I wanted to understand — when buyers call you through PNS, are you generally unavailable at that time, or is there another reason the calls are getting missed? Because our data shows you're only answering about 4 out of every 10 incoming buyer calls, which is at 40.3% against a 60% threshold.
script_parts_en.value_demo: Sellers in the locks category in Aligarh who maintain a PNS answer rate above 60% consistently retain more buyer conversations — at your current 40.3%, roughly 3 to 4 out of every 6 buyers who call are reaching a competitor before you even get a chance to speak with them.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your PNS availability schedule and we'll set the time slots to only the hours when you are genuinely free to take calls, so the system rings you only when you can actually pick up; it will take about 5 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: Just this one change today, ji — once the PNS timing is corrected, lead response should improve naturally over the next two weeks; no big commitment, just this single step.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
